purpose: Visualise filing/warning -> institutional response -> protection/control -> continuing parallel life -> consequence, while preserving criminal proof boundaries.
controls: No finding of criminal capture, collusion, malicious prosecution, prevaricacion or institutional shielding is made.
Neutralisation/shielding is first measured as practical effect; criminal upgrade requires actor-specific act, duty, knowledge, intent, causation and benefit/harm.
No-response-located remains a corpus gap, not proof of absence.
Adverse judicial acts are shown beside protective/favourable acts.
LPB estate and third-party property remain distinct.
Downstream investors, regulators, public authorities and operators are not attributed knowledge from exposure alone.
France/Brussels/EU actor-specific attribution remains disabled until an exact source/filing/receipt/response bridge is controlled.
2018 recovered LexNET nodes are supplemental and must be deduplicated before canonical denominator promotion.
